author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, BiGRU=160) — kernel_size=9 — seed=42
abstract: Middle-ground kernel to trade off motif span vs PRS stability: conv k=9 with otherwise identical dual-expert setup. Tests whether it preserves PRS while improving ncRNA/APA.
